  client: string;
  status: ProjectStatus;
  done: number;
  total: number;
  due: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  members: string[];
  starred: boolean;
  color: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;

const dayFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  month: "short",
  day: "numeric",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

export function formatDay(value: string) {
  return dayFormat.format(new Date(`${value.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`));
}
